what_this_shows: Both the equity and option demo trades re-run directly against the deployed instance (https://amanahtrader.uk), not a local checkout, so the deployment's own database captures them the way a judge opening the live URL would actually see -- closing the gap CLAUDE.md's known limitation 4 flagged: a locally-run trade is invisible to any deployment because backend/*.db is gitignored per checkout.
host: self-managed DigitalOcean VPS (Ubuntu 24.04, nginx, systemd, real Let's Encrypt TLS) -- Replit is retired

trades.note: First attempt failed BROKER_SUBMISSION with MCP_CLIENT_UNAVAILABLE -- the local .env's ALPACA_MCP_COMMAND override was a Windows-specific absolute path (E:\Github2\...\uvx.exe) copied verbatim to the VPS via scp. Fixed by removing the override on the VPS so it falls back to the portable default (`uvx alpaca-mcp-server`, resolved via PATH). Retried on the same queue_id since nothing had reached the broker yet; second attempt filled cleanly.

Rested at the live bid for roughly 2.5 minutes before crossing -- thinner liquidity than the equity leg, but well inside the 20:00Z expiry window. option fill correctly recorded in paper_fills only, per known limitation 2 (option positions are not tracked in the equity ledger).

verified_via: GET https://amanahtrader.uk/portfolio returning both fills (fill_count: 2) and the CVX position, independent of the reconcile responses recorded above
